The method is supposed to find the next index of a given character in an input array.  
It operates on a character 'c', the current position 'pos', the length of the array, and the array 'input'.  
It iterates through the array starting from 'pos', checking if the current character matches 'c'.  
It returns the index of the character relative to 'pos', or -1 if not found.
